Name: Sandeep Bhushan
Bio:
Sandeep Bhushan is a Visiting Faculty at XLRI and Guest Faculty at Plaksha University, where he teaches strategic marketing and entrepreneurship.

Sandeep brings more than 25 years of experience across corporate India, having worked with leading Indian and global companies. As India Director for the Meta Business Group, he led Meta for Business operations in India. Earlier in his career, he produced consumer brands and go-to-market strategies at Unilever and served as Director of Marketing at Samsung. At the Hindustan Times Group, he was a founding member and Chief Operating Officer of Mint, the business news publication.

Sandeep currently serves on the board of a consumer health company and is a Partner at Social Venture Partners. He has also served on the boards of the Advertising Standards Council of India and the Mobile Marketing Association, where he helped accelerate digital adoption and advance key industry standards.
Education: PGP, IIM Ahmedabad | EFPM, Indian School of Business (Doctoral candidate) | B.Com (Honours), Delhi University
Research_Interests: Path to Product Market Fit for startups | Venture Capital and impact of Product Market Fit on staged investment | Strategy and Marketing | Digital Ecosystems | Early stage Startups
